scope: Only explicit paper-native monthly investment experiments; no daily/weekly/quarterly retiming. Daily historical inputs may support genuine monthly decisions.
admission: Attributable runnable central source/policy OR a complete paper-specified central algorithm. Original author outputs/checkpoints are not required merely to rerun a fully implemented algorithm; missing central mapping cannot be silently invented.
clock: Preserve each admitted paper native monthly decision timing, with strictly asof information and the next executable quote. Record calendar-month portfolio NAV for actual published monthly-factor attribution; do not silently shift factors or substitute monthly reports of daily decisions.
portfolio: Source-specific funded rule fixed before outcomes; exact self-finance costs/cash/drift, no pre-fill returns, no omitted held delistings. Raw CRSP total returns/flags used once; incomplete payoffs or missing held returns cannot be zero-filled. Source rule-to-portfolio ambiguities block faithful primary admission rather than being selected by performance.
costs: 10bp per side primary with0/25bp predeclared sensitivities where compatible with source; any different native fee rule remains a separately labelled comparison.
data: Permanent identifiers and historical membership, physical future-row-removal input gates, source field units and filing availability, no evaluation matrices passed into generation. Present-day restatement/model vintages disclosed, no pristine snapshot claim.
calendar: Complete predeclared native or defensibly transferred historical period fixed before outcomes. A longer period requires a new pre-outcome binding; training months are not counted as evaluation observations.
inference: Actual FF5+MOM+JKP132 span with rank/intercept/df checks on the complete declared monthly calendar; no pseudoinverse alpha for unidentified short paths. FF6 may be a named sensitivity only. Preserve2pp/year margin and original69 family denominator; no zero-alpha imputation or missing-case removal. HAC uncertainty is approximate and prior persistence undercoverage stays disclosed.
blocked_execution_rule: If executable cohort is empty, no strategy source/model/portfolio job is submitted and no economic result is manufactured. The economic study remains incomplete and the paper provisional.
provider_budget: Strict project total<1000 including historical and uncertain charges; current800runtime limit and legacy caps unchanged. No paid adaptation is opened by this empty admission.
